Our Story

Zaiqnama means “story of flavours” in Urdu, and every dish on our menu tells one. We began as a small family kitchen, and today we serve biryani, BBQ and karahi made from the same recipes our grandmothers trusted.

About Zaiqnama

Our Story

Zaiqnama means "story of flavours" in Urdu. We opened in 2012 with six tables and one big stove, and a promise: cook every dish the way it is cooked at home, only better.

🎯

Mission

To serve honest, flavourful Pakistani food at fair prices.

🔭

Vision

To be the most loved desi restaurant in the country.

✅

Quality Commitment

Fresh ingredients daily, no artificial colours, and a spotless kitchen.
